summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 9 million Class A ordinary shares at $20.00 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase 1 million shares at $19.9999 per warrant, raising $190 million in net proceeds. The offering is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation. Joint bookrunning managers include Leerink Partners, Guggenheim Securities, Cantor, and LifeSci Capital. Delivery is expected on June 25, 2026. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. Filing is a routine follow-on offering under Rule 424(b)(5).
